research_page.title: GWAS of neuropathology endophenotypes (Fardo et al., 2024)
research_page.description: A large-scale GWAS of autopsied brains identified novel genetic risk loci for specific dementia-related neuropathologies, including APOC2 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy.
research_page.authors_line_md: David W. Fardo et al. — University of Kentucky
research_page.takeaway_md: By running GWAS against specific brain pathologies rather than clinical diagnoses, researchers identified novel genetic drivers for vascular dementia contributors (*COL4A1*, *LZTS1*, *APOC2*). The study also clarified that some known dementia risk genes (like *GRN* and *TMEM106B*) primarily drive non-Alzheimer's pathologies such as hippocampal sclerosis and LATE, rather than classic amyloid or tau.
key_findings_md: Identified three novel risk loci: *LZTS1* for arteriolosclerosis, *COL4A1* for atherosclerosis, and *APOC2* for cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) (paper, Table 2).
The *APOC2* locus association with CAA remained highly significant even after adjusting for known *APOE* alleles, marking an independent genetic risk factor in the APOE region (paper, Results).

Known dementia loci *TMEM106B* and *GRN* were significantly associated with non-AD pathologies (hippocampal sclerosis and LATE-NC) but not with classic amyloid plaques or neurofibrillary tangles (paper, Results).
research_page.methods_md: Genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis of 7,804 deceased participants from the NACC, ROSMAP, and ACT cohorts with available autopsy and genotype data.
research_page.trial_evidence_md: The novel loci (*APOC2*, *COL4A1*, *LZTS1*) are foundational discoveries with no active clinical trials targeting them for dementia. While the study reinforces the role of *GRN* in non-AD pathologies, clinical translation of the *GRN* pathway recently faced a major setback when the Phase 3 [INFRONT-3](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04374136) trial of latozinemab for FTD-GRN was terminated for lack of efficacy.
research_page.sentiment_md: Public and investor sentiment is quiet, as the findings represent early-stage foundational genetics rather than actionable therapeutic breakthroughs. Media coverage was largely limited to standard institutional press releases.
caveats_md: The study population was restricted to participants of European descent, limiting the generalizability of these genetic associations to other ancestries.

Three examined pathologies (gross infarcts, microinfarcts, and Lewy bodies) yielded no genome-wide significant loci, likely due to sample size constraints or heterogeneity in grading across research centers.
relates_to_md: [Amyloid hypothesis](/research/amyloid-hypothesis) — Provides genetic nuance by separating *APOE*'s effects on general amyloid plaques from *APOC2*'s independent effect on vascular amyloid (CAA).
[Biomarkers](/research/biomarkers) — Demonstrates the value of linking genetic risk loci directly to specific neuropathology endophenotypes rather than broad clinical diagnoses.

timeline_entries.title: 2026-01 — INFRONT-3 trial (latozinemab) terminated
timeline_entries.body_md: The Phase 3 [INFRONT-3](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04374136) trial of latozinemab, targeting the *GRN* pathway in frontotemporal dementia, was terminated after failing to meet its primary efficacy endpoint.
